model_output.rationale: CO-119 + N435 on GP therapy lines is the KX threshold denial. No KX was submitted, and the 2026-07-08 chart note documents skilled, medically necessary therapy on the DOS — so KX may be attested. Part B FFS does not accept frequency 7; vehicle is a clerical-error reopening.

root_cause.explanation: All three lines (97140-GP, 97530-GP, 97110-GP) denied CO-119 with MOA N435 — therapy threshold reached. The 837P lines carry GP only; no KX modifier was appended despite a DOS chart note supporting continued medically necessary skilled therapy.

next_action.detail: File a clerical-error reopening with Novitas (within 1 yr of DOS) on claim control 2622720095805, adding KX alongside GP on all three lines. Do not send frequency 7 — Part B rejects it. Retain the 2026-07-08 note as support.

evidence.fact: All 3 lines denied CO-119, $147.16 total, MOA N435, filing indicator MB
97140/97530/97110 submitted with GP only — no KX modifier
2026-07-08 PT note, 45 timed minutes, 'skilled services remain medically necessary' — justification dated on the DOS
CO-119+N435 with no KX and justification on/before DOS → correct_and_resubmit by clerical-error reopening; never bill_patient on CO-119

citations.rule: CO-119 + N435 = therapy threshold denial; missing KX with dated justification → clerical-error reopening (Part B has no '7')
CO = provider liability, never billable to the Medicare beneficiary
